about_the_game:
Our best deal ever! You’ll get a massive 3400 Palia Coins, plus 8 different premium outfits to immerse yourself in each of Palia’s skills and the Honey Bumble Pet. You’ll also get 4 exclusive Courier slots for your pets - allowing you to free up valuable inventory space on the go, allowing you to gather, mine, fish, catch, and hunt more thanks to help from your trusted companion!

Includes:

- 3400 Palia Coins

- Honey Bumble Pet

- Founder Courier Pet Slots (4 Slots)

- Harvelia Work Sprout Tender Outfit

- Local Catch Gillyfin Outfit

- Honeybunch Beekeeper Outfit

- Lumberjack Flapjacked Outfit

- Buckaroo Bone Dry Outfit

- Patisserie Baker Outfit

- Proper Prospector Surface Outfit

- Carpenter Skyscraper Outfit

- Professional's Toolskin: Axe

- Professional's Toolskin: Bow

- Professional's Toolskin: Fishing Rod

- Professional's Toolskin: Hoe

- Professional's Toolskin: Pick Axe

- Professional's Toolskin: Watering Can

Palia Coins are in-game currency that can be spent in Palia. You can purchase new customization items in the Premium Store!
